title: Please allow WallpaperFader to be disabled for Breeze theme in both SDDM and Lockscreen
line: The Breeze lock and login screens get an option to stop blurring and dimming the wallpaper behind the prompt.
explanation: The Breeze lock screen (LockScreenUi.qml) and the Breeze SDDM theme (Main.qml) always show WallpaperFader, which blurs, dims and recolours the wallpaper while the prompt is visible, and neither had a setting for it. The lock screen theme config gains a blurWallpaper option (default on) shown as "Wallpaper: Blur behind unlocking prompt" in Screen Locking > Configure Appearance, and the fader is hidden when it is off; the prompt still fades out on idle as before. The SDDM theme reads a new blurBackground key (default true in theme.conf), and the SDDM KCM's Change Background dialog gets a "Blur behind login prompt" checkbox next to "Show clock" that writes it to theme.conf.user, the same way the clock option works.

commits.message:
lockscreen, sddm-theme: allow turning off the wallpaper blur

The Breeze lock and login screens always blurred and dimmed the
wallpaper behind the prompt. Add a lock screen appearance option and a
blurBackground theme.conf key for SDDM so users can turn that off.

BUG: 455757

Add option to turn off the background blur in Breeze theme

The Breeze login screen always blurred the background behind the login
prompt, with no way to change it. Add a checkbox next to "Show clock"
that writes the theme's new blurBackground key to theme.conf.user.

BUG: 455757

patches.diff:
From 3c537c802b3e7ebcebab740cb69faaeb5211c63a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 23:46:30 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] lockscreen, sddm-theme: allow turning off the wallpaper blur

The Breeze lock and login screens always blurred and dimmed the
wallpaper behind the prompt. Add a lock screen appearance option and a
blurBackground theme.conf key for SDDM so users can turn that off.

BUG: 455757
---
 .../contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml        |  1 +
 desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/config.qml   | 17 +++++++++++++++++
 desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/config.xml   |  4 ++++
 sddm-theme/Main.qml                             |  2 +-
 sddm-theme/theme.conf.cmake                     |  1 +
 5 files changed, 24 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml
index 065a33c131..bb70bd6862 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml
@@ -236,6 +236,7 @@ Item {
 
         WallpaperFader {
             anchors.fill: parent
+            visible: config.blurWallpaper
             state: lockScreenRoot.uiVisible ? "on" : "off"
             mainStack: mainStack
             footer: footer
diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/config.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/config.qml
index 0ac9414ae8..dca83449be 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/config.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/config.qml
@@ -12,6 +12,9 @@ Kirigami.FormLayout {
     property bool cfg_alwaysShowClockDefault: true
     property bool cfg_hideClockWhenIdleDefault: false
 
+    property alias cfg_blurWallpaper: blurWallpaper.checked
+    property bool cfg_blurWallpaperDefault: true
+
     property alias cfg_showMediaControls: showMediaControls.checked
     property bool cfg_showMediaControlsDefault: false
 
@@ -63,6 +66,20 @@ Kirigami.FormLayout {
         }
     }
 
+    QQC2.CheckBox {
+        id: blurWallpaper
+        Kirigami.FormData.label: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop",
+                                        "@title: group",
+                                        "Wallpaper:")
+        text: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop",
+                     "@option:check",
+                     "Blur behind unlocking prompt")
+
+        KCM.SettingHighlighter {
+            highlight: configForm.cfg_blurWallpaperDefault != configForm.cfg_blurWallpaper
+        }
+    }
+
     QQC2.CheckBox {
         id: showMediaControls
         Kirigami.FormData.label: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop",
diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/config.xml b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/config.xml
index be1577386d..b5d5decdef 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/config.xml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/config.xml
@@ -15,6 +15,10 @@
       <label>Hide clock when prompt is hidden.</label>
       <default>false</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="blurWallpaper" type="Bool">
+      <label>If true, blurs and dims the wallpaper while the unlocking prompt is shown.</label>
+      <default>true</default>
+    </entry>
     <entry name="showMediaControls" type="Bool">
       <label>If true, shows any currently playing media along with controls to pause it.</label>
       <default>true</default>
diff --git a/sddm-theme/Main.qml b/sddm-theme/Main.qml
index 3379ead93e..2b0f9dbcb1 100644
--- a/sddm-theme/Main.qml
+++ b/sddm-theme/Main.qml
@@ -104,7 +104,7 @@ Item {
             }
         }
         WallpaperFader {
-            visible: config.type === "image"
+            visible: config.type === "image" && config.blurBackground !== "false"
             anchors.fill: parent
             state: loginScreenRoot.uiVisible ? "on" : "off"
             source: wallpaper
diff --git a/sddm-theme/theme.conf.cmake b/sddm-theme/theme.conf.cmake
index 7436cece1f..1ed3f66079 100644
--- a/sddm-theme/theme.conf.cmake
+++ b/sddm-theme/theme.conf.cmake
@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 [General]
 showlogo=hidden
 showClock=true
+blurBackground=true
 logo=${KDE_INSTALL_FULL_DATADIR}/sddm/themes/breeze/default-logo.svg
 type=image
 color=#1d99f3
--

Breeze SDDM theme on master (rendered in the qml runtime with blurBackground=false): the key is ignored, background blurred
Breeze SDDM theme with the fix and blurBackground=false: the background stays sharp behind the login prompt
